name: Galeazzi Fracture-Dislocation
definition: Fracture of the radial shaft associated with distal radioulnar joint disruption or instability.

investigations.principle: Radiographs must include wrist and elbow; CT may assist DRUJ or complex fracture assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Adult Galeazzi injuries usually require operative fixation and DRUJ assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna/Sandhi instability concepts may be documented only after modern management.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the radial shaft associated with distal radioulnar joint disruption or instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
